title: R08: Pets scope reads currentFamilyId itself; stale family after switch leads to writes into the wrong family
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/pets/page.tsx:28-50 (useFamily(); refresh deps [family,user]); pets-page-content.tsx:101 (useFamily) and :180 (createPet familyId from context)
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/lib/use-pets-data.ts:41-66 (resolveCurrentFamilyId inside load, deps [user] only); apps/ios/app/(tabs)/pets.tsx:84,139,259,267,284 (familyId passed to PetForm/ReminderForm/ExpenseForm)
current_ios: usePetsData resolves users/{uid}.currentFamilyId once per user change and keeps it in local state. FamilyProvider.switchFamily (state/family-context.tsx:74-80) updates context only, so the mounted Pets tab keeps family A's pets/reminders/expenses AND keeps familyId=A, so new pets/reminders/expenses are created in family A after the user switched to B. A failed users/{uid} read rejects load() (no catch), and per-query catch(() => []) makes a load error look like the 0-pet empty state.
target: Pets data is keyed on the family-context scope. Switching family, joining or leaving re-fetches and changes the write scope at the same moment. An unknown or failed scope never falls back to personal writes.
fix_plan: In use-pets-data.ts: import { useFamily } from '@/state/family-context'; const { family, loading: familyLoading } = useFamily(); const familyId = family?.familyId ?? null. Remove the resolveCurrentFamilyId call and the familyId useState. load() early-returns while familyLoading. Make load's deps [user, familyId] and add `useEffect(() => { if (!familyLoading) void load(false); }, [load, familyLoading])`. Add a request-generation ref (`const gen = useRef(0); const my = ++gen.current; ... if (my !== gen.current) return;`) before each setState so a slow family-A response can't overwrite family B. Reset selectedPetId to null when familyId changes. Return familyId from the context value so pets.tsx keeps passing it to the forms. Also make the FAB/forms no-ops while familyLoading is true. Pair this with PETS-3 (error state) so a failed read never shows the empty state.

title: Pets tab never refetches on focus; data goes stale after walks/reminders change elsewhere
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/pets/page.tsx:47-50 and pets-page-content.tsx:148-150 (refetch on every route mount)
ios_ref: apps/ios/src/lib/use-pets-data.ts:68-70 (load only on mount/user change); no useFocusEffect anywhere in apps/ios
current_ios: Expo Router keeps the Pets tab mounted, so after recording a walk (walk-days stat), completing a reminder on Home, or editing a pet on another screen, the Pets tab shows stale numbers until a manual pull-to-refresh.
target: Fresh data each time the tab gains focus, like the web which remounts per navigation.
fix_plan: In pets.tsx, `import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router'` and add `useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { if (!loading) void refresh(); }, [refresh]))`. Use a silent refresh: add `load(isRefresh, {silent:true})` that doesn't toggle `refreshing`, so the RefreshControl spinner doesn't flash. Also bump healthKey inside the same callback so health records reload (see PETS-21).

title: A load failure renders as the 0-pet empty state, with no error or retry
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/pets/page.tsx:59-74 (loading text, then empty state; web also lacks an error state, flagged as R08 'unknown/error vs empty')
current_ios: A network or permission failure on listPetsForScope returns [], and the screen shows '還沒有寵物 / 新增第一隻寵物', which invites creating duplicate pets.
target: Keep a distinct error state: a centered card with Error.title and an Error.retry button. Never show the add-first-pet empty state when the pets query failed.
fix_plan: In use-pets-data.ts, let listPetsForScope reject (no catch) and keep a catch only on the secondary lists. Wrap load in try/catch, `setError(true)` on failure and clear it on success, and expose `error`. In pets.tsx, before the `pets.length === 0` branch, add `if (error && pets.length === 0)`. It renders `<EmptyState emoji="⚠️" title={t('Error.title')} ctaLabel={t('Error.retry')} onPressCta={refresh} />` (or the lucide AlertCircle once EmptyState supports icons).

title: Reminders tab is missing the summary row ('本月 X 條 · 已完成 Y' + sort hint)
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/pets/pet-reminders-body.tsx:40-59 (totalThisMonth/doneCount), 71-81 (summary row); pets-page-content.tsx:128-130 (listRecentlyCompletedReminders, family only, default last 24h)

target: Above the list, a row (px 4, pb 4, space-between, baseline): PetsPage.reminders.summary {total, done} (12px, 600, ink2) and PetsPage.reminders.sortHint (12px, ink3). total = the set of active reminders for this pet triggering this month, unioned with done-this-month. done = done-this-month count.
fix_plan: No extra query is needed: listRemindersForScope (pets-data.ts:12-29) already returns done reminders, because it doesn't filter `done`. Render the row only when list.length>0 || doneCount>0, else the empty card (PETS-9).
